answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake bond: each identity must lock a deposit before it can act, like a pearl held in escrow, and the deposit is slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicates. A prism of independent attestors checks behavior from different angles, so one fake account cannot vouch for itself, and a public mirror ledger makes every bond and slash visible to all. An attacker must fund a fresh bond for every fake identity, so spawning thousands of Sybils costs thousands of deposits, while honest users pay nothing beyond the temporary lock.
